description: Ethiopian Airlines Dakota displayed landside on the Ring Road at the north-west corner of Bole International Airport. Painted as ET-T-1 which was the registration of Ethiopian Airlines' first DC-3 and is a commemorative marking rather than this airframe's identity; the true identity is ET-AIA. Photographed on display October 2019 and the location was refreshed by Spottingmode in July 2025.
museum_name: Addis Ababa Bole International Airport DC-3 Display
